_comment: Legal Document Version Manifest - Per-Product Schema
_description: This file tracks version numbers for legal documents across all Ethervox product lines. Used by apps to detect when users need to re-consent to updated terms/privacy policy.
_schema_changes: Migrated from flat structure to per-product-line schema. Each product line now tracks its own legal document versions independently.
_instructions: 1. Update the document on the website (e.g., privacy.html, terms.html)
2. Update the version number in the HTML comment at the top of that file
3. Update the corresponding version number in this file under the appropriate product line
5. Add a brief summary of what changed
7. Update legal version constants in the app's code
8. Release new app version with updated version checks

voice._description: Voice line: Friend'O'Mine Android, Friend'O'Mine iOS, ESP32 satellite

terms_of_service.summary: Removed advertising references (app is now ad-free)

privacy_policy.summary: Removed AdMob and all advertising infrastructure (app is now fully local, ad-free)

third_party_licenses.summary: Removed AdMob SDK and UMP SDK entries

workspace._description: Workspace line: macOS, iPadOS, Windows, Linux file manager/viewer/editor

terms_of_service.summary: Initial version for Workspace product line (local-first, no third-party services)

privacy_policy.summary: Initial version for Workspace product line (fully local processing, no data collection)

third_party_licenses.summary: Initial version for Workspace product line

_legacy_note: This file previously used a flat structure. As of 2026-08-10, it uses a per-product-line schema. Legacy apps referencing top-level 'terms_of_service' or 'privacy_policy' should migrate to the 'voice' product line schema.
